name: frame_rear
note: Upright as on the robot. Tree supports (auto). M5 inserts in the arm pad, M3 inserts in the knuckle faces.

name: frame_front
note: Stand it on its flat cut face. Tree supports (auto). M4 inserts in the caster bosses, M3 inserts for the driver.

name: frame_pod_left
note: Lay the motor face plate flat on the bed. M3 inserts in the knuckle faces.

name: frame_pod_right
note: Mirror of the left pod. Lay the face plate flat on the bed.
